name: smwgraphics-terranigma-beruga-s-tower
title: Terranigma - Beruga's Tower
description:
The background seen in various sections of the final dungeon, from Terranigma. My version uses one less tile, has better map 16 and optimizations in general. I didn't rip the color animation from the original because it uses very complex palette rotation. A great fit for factory levels, in general.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
